analysis: The supplied changes are documentation only. AGENTS.md (head lines 340-437) is contributor workflow and code-structure guidance, including the CachedStore invalidation rule at line 340 and PR/signing rules; it changes no runtime behavior. CHANGELOG.md has one patch hunk at line 214 (base) / 214 (head), which replaces the DevNet line 'dev VM boot path now sets EIGENINFERENCE_IPAPI_KEY'. The new entry says the dev coordinator uses the production env contract, that deploy/gcp/dev/seed-env.sh seeds /etc/d-inference/env from env-overrides, Secret Manager and deploy/environments/prod.env, and that swap.sh does the swaps. It adds that the old vm-startup.sh, refresh-env.sh, cloudbuild.yaml and bootstrap.sh are removed, and that host-setup formats only a verified blank disk. It also lists hard gates (root-owned seed state, no DB credentials in argv, restore on failure). None of the actual deploy scripts or env files were supplied, so these claims are unverified. Dev is out of scope in the threat model. The only concern for a later pass is whether dev seeding could pull production secrets (A-005, A-006, A-008) or production credentials into the dev environment, or whether the prod swap shares code with the production deploy path. No threat-model assertions (TB-002, TB-009, etc.) are altered by these units. No findings. The shell scripts and env templates need their own review when their units are supplied.
